name: academiasync
description: Learning management system: a Next.js frontend, two Express services and PostgreSQL

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend/user-service && npm run test --workspace backend/course-service && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace backend/user-service && npm run test:coverage --workspace backend/course-service && npm run test:coverage --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend/user-service && npm run lint --workspace backend/course-service && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace backend/user-service && npm run format:check --workspace backend/course-service
